copy.tagline: 引导新用户快速熟悉产品
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想为新用户提供友好的产品导览
copy.tagline_en: Guide new users through your product quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to offer a friendly product tour to first-time users

howto.what: 装上后，当新用户第一次和 omo 对话时，Claude 会充当引导员，按顺序介绍六个环节：功能导览、迁移帮助、历史会话分析、价值估算、记忆记录和 init-deep 提议；记忆记录贯穿整个过程。并用用户使用的语言回应。
howto.when: 新用户第一次使用 omo 并开始对话时自动触发一次；之后随时可用 senpi --onboard 唤回。

say.text: 我从 Claude Code 迁移过来，能帮我把配置搬过去吗？
say.note: 触发迁移环节：扫描旧配置并给出迁移计划。

say.text: 可以，你翻翻我以前写代码的历史会话吧。
say.note: 同意后进行历史会话分析，用于推断工作习惯。

say.text: 什么是 ulw？能讲给我听吗？
say.note: 引导员会解释 ulw 关键字的作用。

howto.what_en: On a new omo user's first conversation, Claude acts as a tour guide for six ordered steps: feature tour, migration help, session archaeology, value mapping, memory recording, and an init-deep proposal. Memory recording runs throughout. It responds in the user's own language.
howto.when_en: Auto-starts on the first conversation a new omo user ever starts, once ever. Relaunchable anytime with `senpi --onboard`; disable with `omo-senpi-onboarding-disabled`.

say_en.text: I'm coming from Claude Code — can you help me migrate my setup?
say_en.note: Starts the migration lane: it scrapes old config and shows a plan.

say_en.text: Sure, go ahead and look through my past coding sessions.
say_en.note: Allows session archaeology to analyze your work habits.

say_en.text: What is `ulw`? Could you explain it to me?
say_en.note: The guide explains what the `ulw` keyword does.
